senses.gloss: m. (סמם, to tie up, close; cmp. תסתיים s. v. סוּם ch.) [that which includes everything,] essence, sum.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:6">Y. Ber. IX, beg. 12ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 18a:11">Meg. 18ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 65:2">Ps. LXV, 2</cite>) <he>ס׳ דכולא משתוקא</he> the sum (the highest) of all (praise) is silence.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:5:2">Y. Snh. XI, 30ᵇ</cite> <he>כל ס׳ דמילתא וכ׳</he> to conclude the matter, it is not this, but &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:15">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> <he>כל ס׳ דמילתא ניתי וכ׳</he> to end the matter, let us bring &c.; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite>.
